VERDICT_REASON: VMLA path shape (64x8192 FP32, localRows>1 on 24/40 cores) shows consistent +3.4% median regression across 6 interleaved P/C pairs (all 6 same direction). In-place accumulator + per-row bias reload + SyncVToMTE2 costs more than fused vmla saves. Controls (non-VMLA shapes) show no systematic change. Same-binary strict gate failed on all shapes (short-kernel drift); P/C run as diagnostic.

SINGLE_CHANGE_AUDIT.mechanism: MulAddDst (vmla) replaces Mul+Add at FP32 full-row epilogue
SINGLE_CHANGE_AUDIT.sync_note: SyncVToMTE2 before per-row bias reload is a correctness requirement of the in-place accumulator (closes V-pipe/MTE2 race), not a performance sync change

samebinary.note: All shapes fail strict drift gate (short-kernel outliers). MAD/med acceptable (0.05-0.08) on 8192-width shapes.

paired.controls_note: Non-VMLA shapes (2x8192, 4x8192, 8x8192, 2x4096, 2x256) show mixed/noisy results consistent with no systematic change
